book.name: ACTS
book.title: In o Oꞌohanas g Haꞌichu hab ha-Juni g Jesus Chuhchai

content: Mash hegam Paul am ha mihshmad Iconium t am

Kutsh am hab waꞌap e juh Iconium t am matsh g Tutuligo hemajkam ab ha wui gegokiwua. Paul ch Barnabas atsh am i wahp ha‑cheopi ed k am si ha mihshmad. Kutsh muꞌi ab i s‑wohoch g Tutuligo mo g Jesus d Jiosh si Kehsha. Kutsh haꞌi hegam mash am ha wehm e mihshmad hab waꞌap ab i s‑wohoch g haꞌichu ha‑ahga.
Tsh wabshaba am i wuwha hegam Tutuligo matsh pi ab hu wohoch k am si i ha kudu g gawul mahs hemajkam. Kutsh idam s‑ha kehꞌel g Paul ch Barnabas ch hegam ehp matsh ab i s‑ha wohoch.

Sh wabshaba tash am oiopo idam Jesus chuhchai ha shahgid ch am si tasho ha mihshmad ab amjed g Jesus pihk elidadag. Tsh heg ab i ha mah g gewkdag mat hab wo wuad g si s‑hasigam haꞌichu k hab masma wohokamch g ha‑ahga.
Tsh hegam hemajkam am i e gawulkai mat haꞌi ab ha wehmt g Jesus chuhchai k haꞌi g ha‑obga ab ha wehmt.
Tsh wehsijj hegam mat ab ha wui gegokiwua g Jesus chuhchai am hahawa i e apꞌech g e‑wanimeddam ha wehm mat wo ha shoꞌigchud k wo ha maꞌichshul.
Mash hegam Paul am ha mihshmad Lystra t am
Tsh idam am i s‑mai mamtsh wo ha shoꞌigch k atsh gm hu wa hekaj baꞌich hahawa ep hihi Lystra kihhim wui. Ihda Lystra o am hab chuꞌig Lyconia jewed ch ed.
Kutsh am dada k am ha ahgid g s‑kehg haꞌichu ahga ab amjed g Jesus.
Sh am ha wui hema daha mash pi himdag ga hu i e‑alijk amjed.
Tsh am i nei g Paul mo hab masma ab si kaiham g ahgaj mo ab si s‑wohochud mo g Jiosh woho ha doajid. Tsh ab si shel i neid
k si s‑kaidam hab kaij, “Oi g kekiwua.” Tsh gam si daꞌiwush g pi himidkam k an has si oimmed.
Tsh am i nei g hemajkam matsh haschu has juh g Paul k ash am si e‑neꞌokikaj hihnk ch hab kaij, “Ia atki haꞌi dada g jijosh oꞌodham e wepogidch.
Id oki d Zeus. Kuki heg d neokdam ch hab d Hermes.” Sh heg hab ahg Paul nash pi heg am neok.
Sh am mia kehk g ha‑cheopi. Kush heg eda am kehshch g Zeus. Tsh am i ha wehmaj g ha‑pahlig. Kutsh am ha uꞌapa g totolo ch haꞌichu heosig mat ab ha wui wo iagchul g Paul ch Barnabas.
Kutsh id pi ha hohhoꞌidach. Tsh hab ab si wantsh g e‑wehschuga k am si wohp ha shahgid g hemajkam k si hihnk ch hab kaij,

“Pi g hab wo t‑elidad machs d jijosh. Dach wabsh oꞌodham hab masma mam ahpim. Ia att dada matt am wo em‑ahgi mamt wo haꞌasa ihm hab masma mo d Jiosh hegai mo pi d wohokam Jiosh. Heg o d wohokam Jiosh mat nahto g dahm kahchim ch jewed kahchim ch wehs haꞌichu mo an hab chuꞌig. Kumt heg wui ab wo i e dagito.
Heki o hu am hab wabsh junihim g hejel e‑tatchui g nahnko mahs hemajkam. Kuki g Jiosh wabsh s‑hemajim ha nakogahim.
K wabshaba chum hekid hab chuꞌig mo am e chehgidahim no pi s‑kehg haꞌichu hab em‑junid ch ab em‑mahkch g juhki ch ab bahijid g haꞌichu em‑eꞌes mamt wo s‑kokwogk ch wo si s‑ap e tahtkkad.”
Neh, bash kaij idam Paul ch wabshaba chum alo pi ha shohbi nash pi chum si tatchua matsh ab haꞌichu wo iagchul ha wui.

Tsh am hahawa haꞌi dada hegam mash wa am ha shoꞌigchud Antiok t am ch Iconium t am k am i ha nuꞌichkwua g hemajkam. Kutsh ab wui gegokiwua g Paul k maꞌichkwua k am i chewaimed k gam hu i wuhshad ab kihhim t amjed k am wua hab elidch mat muh.

Tsh wabshaba am e chehm hegam mo ab ihm g Jesus k an wehgaj gegok g Paul. Tsh gam si i wamig k gam hu uhpam hih kihhim wui. Matsh ab uhpam dada hegam Paul matsh ab amjed gam hu ha mihshmedo Am baꞌich d i tash. Tsh gam hu hahawa hihi Derbe wui hegam Paul
k an i ha ahgidahi g Jesus haꞌichu ahga. Kutsh muꞌijj ab i s‑wohoch. Tsh am hahawa hihi Lystra wui ch Iconium wui ch Antiok wui
k am si i ha gewkemhun mat am wo hihimad ch ab wo si hiwgad g Jesus. Ha‑mashchama ash hab masma matt hemho wa muꞌi haꞌichu wo nakog k am haha wo i wahp Jiosh kihdag ed.

Tsh am hahawa i ha chuhcha hegam mat d wo ha wanimeddamk am ha shaꞌashagid mo hebai i e wehm e nanmek. Sh am hahawa wehsijj wabsh e hoꞌigeꞌidahun ch hab heꞌekkio pi e gegosid. Sh idam Jesus chuhchai ab hahawa i ha dadagitod Jiosh wui.
Neh, batsh wa masma am gahi wuwha g Pisidia jewed k gm hu dada Pamphylia jewed ch ed
k am ha mihshmdahim Perga kihhim ch ed ch amjed gm hu hahawa ep hihi Attalia kihhim t am.
Tsh am i e nahto g ha‑chikpan. Kutsh am gahi i shul ge shuhdagi ch ed an geꞌe wahlko ch ed k gam hu dada hegai Antiok t am mamtsh am i ha dagito Jiosh hemajimatalig ed.

Tsh am wehsijj i e hemapai hegam mash ab ihm g Jesus amai. Sh g Paul ch Barnabas am ha ahgid mat g Jiosh am si i ha wehmt k ab ha mah g nahnko mahs hemajkam g apꞌedag mat ab wo i s‑wohoch g haꞌichu ha‑ahga ab amjed g Jesus.
Tash ash am dadkkahim ha wehm hegam mash ab ihm g Jesus amai Antiok t am.
